engineering_plan.summary: The project will introduce an agentic AI system to automate supply chain processes at AstraSpace Systems, enhancing efficiency, compliance, and performance tracking across vendor interactions.

phases.objective: Confirm requirements and prepare data clean-up plan.

architecture.summary: The high-level system design for the Vendor & Partner SCM Automation using Agentic AI focuses on automating supplier onboarding, sourcing, procurement, delivery tracking, invoice reconciliation, and supplier performance management while ensuring human oversight and compliance.

components.name: Supplier Management Module
components.responsibility: Automate supplier onboarding, qualification, and screening processes.

components.name: Sourcing and RFQ Module
components.responsibility: Draft RFQs, collect and compare supplier quotes.

components.name: Purchase Order Management
components.responsibility: Prepare, amend, and track purchase orders.

components.name: Delivery Tracking Module
components.responsibility: Track order status, predict delivery delays, and alert stakeholders.

components.name: Invoice Reconciliation Module
components.responsibility: Match invoices to purchase orders and goods receipts, handle discrepancies.

components.name: Supplier Performance Dashboard
components.responsibility: Provide scorecards and trend views for supplier performance.

components.name: Human Oversight and Audit Module
components.responsibility: Manage approvals, maintain audit trails, and provide a management dashboard.

integrations.purpose: Manage purchase orders, receipts, and invoices.

nfr_mapping.nfr: Response time for quote comparison under 5 minutes.
nfr_mapping.design_response: Implement asynchronous processing and caching results.
Adopt multi-AZ deployment and redundancy measures.
Implement security protocols and access controls.

nfr_mapping.nfr: Protecting data in transit and at rest.
nfr_mapping.design_response: Utilize TLS for data transmission and AES-256 for data storage.
Include source citations and reasoning in output.
Set up automated compliance auditing processes.
Define quality assurance processes and validation steps.
Develop a cohesive user interface for all agent outputs.
Develop REST APIs for all core functionalities.
Implement multi-language support in user interfaces.

architecture.complexity_rationale: The system involves multiple integrations, complex data flows, and high-performance requirements, necessitating careful design and validation.

tech_stack.summary: This document outlines the technology stack options for automating supply chain management processes at AstraSpace Systems, considering the business requirements and constraints defined in the BRD.

options.name: Option 1 - MERN Stack
pros: High familiarity among the team with React and Node.js.
Scalability offered by MongoDB and AWS services.
cons: May require complex data modeling as transactions grow.
Integration complexity with legacy ERP system.

options.name: Option 2 - Java/Spring with AWS
pros: Strong typing and structure with Java, improving long-term maintainability.
Good community support for integration with various systems.
cons: Higher resource demand compared to JavaScript alternatives.
Longer development time due to the complexity of Java frameworks.

options.name: Option 3 - Django with PostgreSQL
pros: Rapid development capability with built-in admin interface.
Easy and clear database management with ORM features.
cons: Low familiarity in the team may extend the learning curve.
Integration with legacy systems can be challenging.

recommendation.rationale: Choosing the MERN stack leverages existing team familiarity, reducing development time while ensuring high scalability to accommodate future growth.
recommendation.timeline_fit: This option aligns with the indicative total duration of approximately 12 months for project delivery.

production_vendor_map.notes: Supports asynchronous processing, suitable for high-load environments.
Supports high availability and offers various integrations.
